fields.label: Project Name
fields.description: Denormalised at save so the statutory report renders without a live lookup, and so a report issued years later still names the project as it stood.

fields.label: Occurred At
fields.description: When the incident happened. The 24-hour notification clock starts here, not at the moment it was reported.

fields.label: Incident Type
fields.options:
Fatality
Injury
Near Miss
Property Damage
Environmental

fields.label: Immediate Actions
fields.description: What was done at the scene. Required on an incident report because 'nothing' is itself a reportable finding.

fields.label: LTI Classification
fields.options:
No lost time
Temporary Total Disability
Temporary Partial Disability
Permanent Partial Disability
Permanent Total Disability
Fatality
fields.description: The loss-time record the statutory report reads. Left EMPTY it means 'not yet classified' and the report REFUSES; it must never be read as zero lost days. 'No lost time' is a positive classification and is a different value from empty.

fields.label: Notification Deadline
fields.description: occurred_at + 24 hours, stamped on save and never recomputed, so editing the record cannot move it. The 24-hour LTI notification window is this app's configured specification; the governing instrument is NOT recorded here because it has not been verified against the source text. Confirm it before relying on this field in a filing.

fields.label: STI Reference
fields.description: SIRC / STC acknowledgement reference from the LTI branch, once notification has been made.
